summaries: A Form 10-K Annual Report for Ascent Industries Co. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022. Relevant to the task: The Consolidated Balance Sheets list 11,085,103 shares issued and 924,504 treasury shares as of December 31, 2022, allowing derivation of a 2022 year-end outstanding total of 10,160,599. The Cover Page discloses shares outstanding as of March 28, 2023 (10,172,266), providing the early 2023 baseline. Note 9 and the Consolidated Statements of Shareholders' Equity document a share repurchase program resulting in 110,404 shares repurchased in 2022. This document establishes the 2022 year-end and early 2023 share counts and repurchase activity, serving as the predecessor baseline to the 2023 fiscal year-end data required for the 2023-to-2024 comparison.

A Form 10-K annual report for Ascent Industries Co. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023. Relevant to the task: The document provides the critical share count data required to assess the change in Total Shares Outstanding between the 2023 fiscal year and early 2024. The Consolidated Balance Sheets disclose 11,085,103 shares issued and 10,094,821 shares outstanding as of December 31, 2023. The cover page reports the number of shares outstanding as of March 28, 2024 (10,124,781). Additionally, Item 5 and Note 9 detail share repurchase activity (143,108 shares repurchased in 2023), offering context on the equity adjustments affecting the outstanding share count. These figures establish the baseline for the 2023 year-end and the most recent available 2024 data point.
